profile.name: Akash Raval
profile.badge: Python & Web Developer • BCA Student, HNGU
profile.hero_lead: BCA student at Smt. B. K. Mehta IT Centre, HNGU. Focused on Python backend engineering, Flask web development, and MySQL databases, with active interests in Full Stack Web Development and Cybersecurity. Co-creator of **CampusSync**.
profile.about_intro: BCA student focused on Python backend development and practical full-stack projects.
profile.about_text:
I am a BCA student at Smt. B. K. Mehta IT Centre, Hemchandracharya North Gujarat University (HNGU), with an expected graduation in 2027.

My primary focus is Python Backend Development, with expertise in creating web applications using Flask and managing relational data with MySQL. I also enjoy Full Stack Web Development and explore Cybersecurity principles to write safer, cleaner code.

In our flagship project, CampusSync (a College ERP System), I worked in a collaborative two-person team. Both of us contributed across the frontend interfaces and the Flask/MySQL backend. We are also developing the companion mobile application.
profile.footer_tagline: Python & Web Developer. BCA student at HNGU, building Flask and MySQL web applications.
profile.meta_description: Akash Raval is a BCA student and Python & Web Developer building Flask and MySQL apps. See projects like CampusSync, skills and certificates.
